goal: Owner decision 2026-11-02: Admin can turn hidden reasoning off or set its level (minimal/low/medium/high) and an optional reasoning token cap per feature; the setting is stored in the route's existing safety_policy JSON as reasoning {mode, maxTokens} (no SQL); OpenRouter calls send reasoning effort none, the effort, or max_tokens accordingly; default output limit is 2000 tokens; defaults are reasoning low with a 512-token cap for ai_council and astrology_report and off for the other features; a reply cut off by the output limit counts as malformed so the fallback runs. Live QA on 2026-11-02 showed DeepSeek v4.1 Flash spent 929/900 and then 1956/2000 output tokens on reasoning and the Council got no usable JSON.
successCriteria: OpenRouter requests carry reasoning effort none when the route mode is off, the effort when a level is set, and max_tokens when a cap is set.
A finish_reason of length on a JSON feature raises malformed_response so the fallback model runs.
Code defaults use 2000 output tokens, low reasoning with a 512 cap for ai_council and astrology_report, off elsewhere, and only allowed fallback reasons.
Admin Model Router shows a Hidden reasoning select and a reasoning token cap and publishes them inside safetyPolicy.reasoning.
Deno, admin and data checks pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL or migration: the setting lives in the existing safety_policy JSON column.
No secret is read or set; deploys and publishing on QA wait for Owner approval.
